t:
In a Deterioration of stocks insurance (other than potatoes), what is the maximum liability of the insurer?

I. Carrying value of stock in books of account
II. Market value of the commodity immediately before the accident
III. Net realisable value of the commodity immediately before the accident
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
With reference to a MLOP Insurance, which of the following are considered as Insurable Standing Charges?

I. Directors remuneration
II. Insurance premium
III. Stationery, postage and telephone
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Under a CECR policy, loss or damage must be caused due to which of the following perils?

I. Inundation
II. Vandalism
III. Frost
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: If a company has four line treaty with a net retention of say, Rs. 1 crore, the maximum limit under the surplus treaty will be _________.
e: Correct answer: Rs. 4 crore (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following needs are addressed in Contractor's All Risks (CAR) insuranceErection All Risk (EAR) insurance policy?

I. Installation of mechanical plant
II. Testing of plants
III. Commissioning of plant
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: ABC Ltd is a contractor company taking contracts for various types of constructions. It wants to take an insurance for its construction plant and machinery. Which type of insurance should the company take?
e: Correct answer: Contractor's Plant and Machinery Insurance (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following criteria needs to be satisfied to be termed as explosion under standard Boiler and Pressure Plant Insurance Policy?

I. Sudden violent explosion
II. Controlled and slow explosion
III. Caused by internal force of steam, gas or fluid pressure causing bodily displacement IV. Caused by external force of steam, gas or fluid pressure causing bodily displacement
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Construction and erection period in a CPI Policy begins on which of the following dates?

I. On the date when work actually commences
II. when items are stored on site
III. On the date on which testing starts
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
With reference to a MLOP Insurance, which of the following are considered as Insurable Standing Charges?

I. Patent fees
II. License fees
III. Interest payable on bank overdrafts
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: KSAV is a shipping company. The Company wants to protect itself from losses due to damage of its ships and other machinery. Which type of insurance should the company take?
e: Correct answer: Erection All Risks Insurance (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Identify the general exclusions in a Erection All Risk (EAR) insurance policy?

I. Loss or damage due to human error
II. Loss due to cessation of malicious damage
III. Loss or damage due to willful negligence
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are general exclusions under the electronic equipment insurance?

I. Damage due to faulty design
II. Damage due to faulty operation
III. Loss destruction or damage directly occasioned by pressure wave caused by aircraft
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Defects liability period in a CPI Policy lasts for 12 months and should not exceed _______ months.
e: Correct answer: 24 months (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Which of the following is correct with regards to a MLOP policy?
o: Sum insured is the net profit plus standing charges
Sum insured is the net profit less standing charge
Sum insured is the gross profit plus standing char
Sum insured is the gross profit less  standing cha
Sum insured is the standard turnover less actual t
e: Correct answer: Sum insured is the net profit plus standing charges (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Any loss or damage occurring due to act of human error shall be indemnified in a Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance policy. Debate. Choose the most appropriate option.
o: The loss or damage caused due to human error shall
The loss or damage caused due to wilful negligence
e: Correct answer: This statement is right (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a Contractors All Risk (CAR) insurance policy the sum assured is the limit of the third party liability also. Debate (Choose the most appropriate answer).
o: The CAR insurance policy does not cover third part
A separate limit of liability has to be selected by the insured for the third party liability section of the policy
e: Correct answer: A separate limit of liability has to be selected by the insured for the third party liability section of the policy (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The time excess or the waiting period is dependent upon:

I. Type of plant or equipment
II. Replacement time for critical items
III. Location of site
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: ___________ mean any fired closed vessel or a combined container piping system in which steam is generated under pressure.
e: Correct answer: Boiler (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Alfatech Limited is a construction company. It has taken a Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance policy for all its sites. It has incurred the following losses at one of its sites. Which of the following losses are general exclusions as per a CPM insurance policy?

I. Damages due to accident of truck used to transport materials at site
II. Penalty imposed by contract labour inspector
III. Damage of chains and ropes on site
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following losses are excluded from the scope of a MLOP Policy?

I. Loss due to willful neglect
II. Delay on account of obtaining import license
III. The insured not having sufficient capital for repairing damaged machinery
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The sum insured in a machine insurance policy should represent the new replacement value of the items but the inflation factor is not considered and the same value is taken for the whole policy period. State your opinion. Choose the most appropriate answer.
o: The sum insured is reviewed at frequent intervals and the value is linked to an acceptable index showing fluctuation in prices
The inflation in prices is not considered as its m
e: Correct answer: The sum insured is reviewed at frequent intervals and the value is linked to an acceptable index showing fluctuation in prices (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Identify the examples of general exclusions in Comprehensive Project Insurance policy.

I. Loss or damage whilst working underground
II. Loss or damage due to rockslide
III. loss of profits due to delayed commissioning following insured material damage
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
ABC limited is an engineering company. It has taken an Erection All Risk (EAR) insurance policy for its factory. It has incurred the following losses at its factory. Which of the following losses are not general exclusions in a EAR insurance policy?

I. Damages due to a faulty floor plan
II. Depreciation of tools and machinery
III. Damages due error of site manager
e: Correct answer: Only III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The Electronic Equipment Insurance Policy applies to the insured items in which of the following conditions?

I. When they are being shifted within the premises
II. When they are being shifted outside the premises
III. When they are at rest
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: As per wordings in a standard EAR and MCE policy, containing endorsements regarding fire/explosions, open storage of construction or erection materials at the site is divided into sub-units which should be separated from each other by a distance of at least ________.
e: Correct answer: 15 meters (from the IC77 question bank).

t: As per the Institute Cargo Clause, after offloading the indigenous goods from the vehicle l, marine policy shall be in force for a maximum period of ____________.
e: Correct answer: 7 days (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Identify the hazards associated to engines such as steam, gas, diesel or petrol.
o: Explosion due to internal pressure and collapse
Complete disruption of the entire turbine due to c
Cracking of cylinder heads and seizure of pistons due to over heating
Risk of toppling over due to overloading, storm, u
e: Correct answer: Cracking of cylinder heads and seizure of pistons due to over heating (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following objects are suitable for a cover under the comprehensive machinery insurance?

I. Printing works
II. Breweries
III. Warehouses
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Mahesh wants to calculate the time excess for an ALOP policy. Advise him the factors to be considered in calculating the same.

I. Type of plant or equipment
II. Replacement time for critical items
III. Reputation of owner
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
In the event which give rise or likely to give rise to a claim under endorsement for advance loss of profits insurance, which of the modes of communication can be used by the insured to communicate with the underwriter?

I. Telephone
II. Telex
III. Telefax
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
The following jobs are a part of which stage of project planning?

I. Transshipments
II. Storage at the ports of discharge
III. Bonded warehouses of customs department
e: Correct answer: Transportation of Project property (from the IC77 question bank).

t: As per the Institute Cargo Clause, after offloading the imported goods from the vessel, marine policy shall be in force for a maximum period of ____________.
e: Correct answer: 60 days (from the IC77 question bank).

t: Who invented the steam engine?
e: Correct answer: James Watt (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In the British market insurance context, what does the term 'Contract Work' mean?
o: Open floater policies where construction is done of similar nature in sufficiently large numbers.
Open floater policies where construction is done f
Special cover which is combination of CAR and EAR
Special cover which is combination of CAR and MCE
e: Correct answer: Open floater policies where construction is done of similar nature in sufficiently large numbers. (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Start-up delay losses are excluded if caused or aggravated by which of the following reasons in a CPI policy?

I. Penalties imposed by authorities
II. Earthquake
III. Fire
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which among the following perils are excluded from the scope of boiler and pressure plant policy?

I. Damage caused by lightning
II. Damage caused by landslide
III. Damage caused due to impact of aircrafts
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
From the following details provided for a MLOP Policy, calculate the sum insured:-

I. variable expenses Rs. 30 lacs
II. Net profit Rs. 40 lakhs
III. Standing charges Rs. 5 lakhs
e: Correct answer: Rs. 45 lakhs (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Identify the types of infrastructure projects that give potential to Engineering Insurance business.

I. Airport construction
II. Consumer Goods Trading
III. Oil and Gas + Pipelines
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: The benefits of machinery insurance are only for the big industrial enterprises. State your opinion. Choose the most appropriate answer.
o: Machinery insurance is only meant for the big indu
Machinery insurance is only meant for all including small /medium- undertakings where machinery may have serious financial and economic consequences
e: Correct answer: Machinery insurance is only meant for all including small /medium- undertakings where machinery may have serious financial and economic consequences (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In the re-engineering context, market surplus engineering treaty is administered by _________.
e: Correct answer: GIC (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following types of machinery are considered as hazardous?

I. Tractors
II. Dumpers
III. Bulldozers
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Protech Limited is a construction company. It has taken a Contractor's Plant and Machinery (CPM) insurance policy for all its sites. It has incurred the following losses at one of its sites. Which of the following losses are general exclusions as per a CPM insurance policy?

I. Damages to material while transit from one site to another
II. Damages to machinery while transit from one site to another
III. Accidental damage of tools by falling
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Normally, an Erection All Risk (EAR) Insurance Policy covers which of the following perils?

I. Human error
II. Landslide
III. Malicious Damage
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: ABC Industries have installed electric motors and generators in their factory.  Which of the following hazards can it face?
o: Failure of hydraulic pipes, defective casting, def
Insulation break-down and failure of mechanical components like bearings, foundation bolts, terminal box
Explosion due to internal pressure and collapse
Cracking of cylinder heads and seizure of pistons
Risk of toppling over due to overloading, storm, u
e: Correct answer: Insulation break-down and failure of mechanical components like bearings, foundation bolts, terminal box (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
In which of the following cases can the premium be adjusted in a CAR policy?

I. Increase or decrease in custom duty
II. Increase or decrease in freight
III. Increase or decrease in prime cost of material
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Which of the following are the steps of an infrastructure and construction project planning process?

I. Feasibility Study
II. Land acquisition and site preparation
III. Award of contract
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC77 question bank).

t: In a Deterioration of stocks insurance (other than potatoes), what is the maximum liability of the insurer?
o: Limited to the cost of commodities immediately bef
Limited to the cost of commodities or market value
Limited to the market value of commodities immediately before the accident
Limited to the net realisable value of commodities
e: Correct answer: Limited to the market value of commodities immediately before the accident (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
As per a machinery insurance policy if in the event of loss or damage, it is found that the sum insured is less than the amount required to be insured, then: -

I. The amount recoverable by the insured gets reduced in such proportion as the sum insured bears to the amount required to be insured
II. The insurer still pays the amount required to recover the loss
III. The insurer pays the complete sum insured
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t:
Testing period in a CPI Policy begins on which of the following dates?

I. On the date when testing starts
II. When items are stored on site
III. When fuel, raw materials or lubricants are first introduced
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC77 question bank).

t: At which stage is the work of loading in conveyance of the project property at the suppliers premises, and its transit up to the construction site is carried out?
e: Correct answer: Transportation of Project property (from the IC77 question bank).
